commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production wearable layer for the Slice & Stitch painted cartoon-human paper doll.
Output one isolated garment on a genuinely transparent 1024 x 1536 portrait canvas. Image 1 is the CANONICAL CLOTHED BODY reference for exact front-view relaxed pose, canvas scale and garment fit ONLY. Image 2 is an approved painted garment for matte cloth texture, soft folded edges, seams and illustration style ONLY. Do not render the reference body or other clothes.
LOCK REGISTRATION: body center x512; neck base y335; shoulders x320 and x700 at y355; waist x350..674 at y690; hips y790; upper arms angle gently out to wrists x267 and x757 at y775; knees y1030; ankles x394 and x630 at y1300; toes/ground y1410. Keep garment exactly where worn, leave unused canvas transparent, NEVER enlarge/recenter to fill the canvas.
Warm richly detailed hand-painted game illustration matching references, matte soft material shading, refined stitchwork. Opaque fabric where appropriate. No hard vector outline, no shiny 3D render, no photograph.
Strict transparency: no human, neck, face, skin, hands, feet, mannequin, background, halo, shadow outside fabric, label, text, floating fragment. Every neck or sleeve opening transparent. All fabric within canvas with clear transparent margins.
GARMENT:

qualityAssurance.visualReview: All 51 new painted families reviewed equipped on the shared body. Representative coats, dresses, aprons, footwear and accessory combinations checked in the fitting room. Open shoes checked at close range on medium and deep skin; all three buckets covered by automated tests.
correctedDuringReview: continuous dress fitting without strip seams
capelet occlusion of inner shoulder straps
qualityAssurance.uiReview: Live game search retains focus. Multiword search, empty recovery, collections, sorting and full catalogue pagination verified. Saved outfit and 156-coin balance remained unchanged. No horizontal overflow at the game panel's existing 600px viewport.

registration.method: Shared body anchors; affine transforms for separates, continuous piecewise-affine SVG meshes for one-piece garments and long coats. No changes to head placement or body rig.
registration.cleanup: Runtime alpha threshold suppresses faint generation halos. Source PNGs are preserved. Open shoes sample opaque skin inside the selected body bucket, independently of fabric dye.

wardrobe.entry: Home clothing chest opens Wardrobe; home mirror opens Face
wardrobe.presentation: Cedar chest with linen drawers, brass handles and category rails
wardrobe.unowned: Preview only. Does not grant ownership, charge coins, equip saved profile or change progression.

knownFamilyAdaptations: Shell tops and halters share the camisole painting; neckline details are not bespoke.
Tea dresses share wrap-dress art; sundresses use a shorter fitted gown.
Paperbag, sailor, jodhpur, jogger, tuxedo and bespoke trousers share tailored-trouser art. Their specialty fastenings and leg shapes remain future refinements.
Mermaid and godet skirts share maxi art; bustle skirts share tiered art.
T-strap heels share Mary Jane art. Monk shoes share Oxfords. Slingback, ribbon, spectator and sculpted heels share pumps without their bespoke straps, ribbons or two-tone panels. Mules share clogs.
Bucket hats share cloche art; pillbox and veiled berets share beret art without a veil. Doctor/frame/top-handle bags share the frame handbag painting.
Tuxedo and bespoke jackets share the existing blazer painting. Several premium coat and apron cuts share a painted silhouette.
All catalogue items keep their existing gameplay, cut, palette, pattern, quality and provenance records. Registered family coverage is not a claim of 389 individually painted silhouettes.
Arbitrary player-crafted future cuts retain the explicit existing fallback until registered. Static front-view clothing rig, not a new animated clothing system.
